title: 一道菜带火一座城①沙县小吃：一个县城，开出8万家店 | One Dish One Town P1 · Shaxian 🥡
description:
8万家店，你家楼下那间沙县，是加盟的还是夫妻店？评论区说说。

【一道菜带火一座城·第1集 沙县小吃】一个福建小县城，把拌面、扁肉、蒸饺、炖罐这"四大金刚"开成了全国超8.8万家门店——比多数洋快餐的总和还多，年营业额超550亿元，遍布全球66个国家和地区。但它靠的不是大资本：集团认证的加盟店只有4000多家，占比不到5%，绝大多数是一家一户的夫妻店。一代沙县人背井离乡，用一碗几块钱的拌面，喂饱了半个中国。这是"一道菜带火一座城"最早、最慢的一座——它花了几十年。

Ep.1 Shaxian. A small county in Fujian turned four cheap staples — mixed noodles, wontons, dumplings, clay-pot soup — into 88,000 shops across China, more than most global fast-food chains combined, 55 billion yuan a year, in 66 countries. Not on big capital: under 5% are official franchises; the rest are hundreds of thousands of mom-and-pop shops. A generation left home to cook, and one bowl of noodles fed half of China — the slowest, oldest way a dish can put a town on the map.

AI-assisted edit; the bilingual subtitles are the narration — no voiceover. Facts checked this run; sources below. Food & industry note, not investment or franchising advice. Footage licensed from Pexels (credited below).
